plan.goal: v0.0.3 — global install dir (~/enough/), bootstrap.sh installer, global defaults via symlinks with 'customize for this project' UI affordance, read allowlist policy, infoworld/ moved global, paradigm text update, infoworld/public/ added.

active_assumptions: macOS only for v0.0.3 — Linux support is on the roadmap but untested
~/enough/ contains everything needed (code + defaults + infoworld + weights + venv). Self-contained install, at the cost of mixing 'app binaries' and 'user data' in one directory.
Symlinks point to wherever enough's defaults/ live (relative to the package location), so dev clones and ~/enough installs both work without hardcoded paths.
The read allowlist is self-governing: it's a policy file that itself can be customized per-project by breaking its own symlink — turtles all the way down.

Path-safety guards the PATH STRING (reject absolute + ../ traversal in user-supplied paths), not the resolved target, so in-tree symlinks pointing outside the project work correctly. The tool-level allowlist is the real gate for 'can the agent read here?'.
continuation_prompt: v0.0.3 shipped. Natural next targets: (1) 'refresh defaults' command to re-symlink customized files back to global (undo of 'customize for this project'); (2) diff view when defaults change upstream — show the user what's different before they symlink back; (3) Linux port (pyinstaller or native bash path resolution); (4) multi-paradigm switch in UI; (5) MOTIVATION.md update ritual at session end. All speculative — watch actual use first.
